1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses DESCRIPTION OF SUPPLY: Procurement of Fire Fighting Delivery Hoses for CISF, BTPS, DVC TOTAL ESTIMATED VALUE: Rs. 405,909.00/- only (excluding GST) IMPORTANT NOTE TO BIDDERS 1. QUALIFYING REQUIREMENT (QR): The bidders must meet the QR criteria of this NIT and m ust submit all relevant documents in support of the same. QR compliance status of the bidder s will be ascertained only from the documents submitted along with the bid & there sh all be no provision of seeking any shortfall documents in respect of QR criteria. 2. ANNEXURE-MD: The bidders must fill Annexure-MD (Compliance of Mandatory Documents) c ompletely & accurately and submit it along with the bid, as the evaluation of bids will be carried o ut solely on the basis of the information furnished in this annexure. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED ONLINE Bidders must upload the signed and filled scan copy of the following documents on Ge M portal (as per formats given at the end of ATC document): 1. Documents in support of qualifying requirement 2. Annexure-MD (Compliance of Mandatory Documents) 3. Declaration regarding Acceptance of All Terms and Conditions (ATC) 4. Techno-commercial sheet 5. Letter of Bid (Annexure -G) 6. Details of Banker for making payment through RTGS/NEFT (Annexure - H) 7. Affidavit for genuineness of the information and authenticity of the documents furnished (to be submitted on non-judicial Stamp Paper of minimum value of Rs. 10 & to be notarized) (Ann exure -I) 8. Power of Attorney (to be submitted on non-judicial Stamp Paper of minimum value of Rs. 10 & to be notarized) (Annexure -J) 9. Certificate for compliance of GOI’s orders 10. Certificate of No Relation in DVC 11. Declaration for compliance to “Conflict of Interest” clause 12. Declaration for compliance to “Prevention of Corruption” clause 13. GST Registration Certificate 14. PAN card 15. Declaration of local content 16. Declaration [Whether the Bidder is presently debarred/banned by any other procuring entity f or violation of ‘Public Procurement (Preference to Make In India)] IMPORTANT NOTE: Two of the above documents i.e. “Affidavit” and “Power of attorney ” must be duly notarized by a notary public and must be on non-judicial stamp paper. Otherwise, they will not be accepted.

QUALIFYING REQUIREMENT A. TECHNICAL CREDENTIAL: 1. The bidder must be either “manufacturer of same or similar category product” or an “authorize d dealer/distributer of that manufacturer”. In case the bid is submitted by any manufacturer, they must furnish necessary documents in support of manufacturing along with their offer. In case the bid is submitted by any dealer/distributor, they must furnish valid dealership/distributorship certifi cate from the manufacturer along with their offer. 2. The bidder must have experience of having completed supply of “same or similar category product” in DVC/SEB/Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/other reputed organization in last 07 (seven) years ending last day of month previous to the one in which offers are invited. 3. The bidder must have experience of having completed supply of “same or similar category product” in DVC/SEB/Govt./Semi Govt./PSU/other reputed organization during last 07 (seven) year s ending last day of month previous to the one in which offers are invited and shall be either of the following: (a) Three completed supplies of same or similar category product each costing not less than the a mount equal to 40% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 162,363.60/- (Rupees One Lakh Sixty-Two Thou sand Three Hundred Sixty-Three and Paise Sixty) only. OR (b) Two completed supplies of same or similar category product each costing not less than the am ount equal to 50% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 202,954.50/- (Rupees Two Lakh Two Thousand Ni ne Hundred Fifty-Four and Paise Fifty) only. OR (c) One completed supply of same or similar category product costing not less than the amount e qual to 80% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 324,727.20/- (Rupees Three Lakh Twenty-Four Thousand Seven Hundred Twenty-Seven and Paise Twenty) only. Note: In case any composite order is submitted as credential, then the exact executed supply ord er value corresponding to the “same or similar category product” will be considered for evaluation and the same needs to be clearly mentioned & should be supported by documentary evidence, oth erwise the credential will not be considered. Completed Supply means: The executed/completed portion of PO/SO, even if it has not been co mpleted in totality. However, completed portion of PO/SO must satisfy technical criteria. Supportin g documents for successful completion of supply has to be provided in the form of certified copies of receipted challan/Tax invoice/Payment receipt document or any relevant documents as applica ble along with related PO/SO copies issued by receiver of material. Same or similar Category product means: Fire fighting delivery hose, Non-percolating (Type-3) . Note: All the figures mentioned above to be considered exclusive of GST. B. FINANCIAL CREDENTIAL: 1. Average Annual Turnover (AAT): The average annual turnover of the bidder during last thre e financial years ending on 31.03.2026 should be at least 30% of the estimated cost i.e. Rs. 121,7 72.70/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty-One Thousand Seven Hundred Seventy-Two and Paise Seventy) only. NOTES for Financial Criteria: (i) In compliance to the above, the bidder shall submit Audited Annual Accounts with Balance shee t and Profit & loss account statements with UDIN No. of preceding 03 (three) financial years endin g on 31.03.2026.

(ii) In case, where audited results for the preceding financial year are not available, certification of financial statements from a practicing Chartered Accountant with UDIN no. shall also be considere d acceptable. ** Important Note for Technical Credential and Financial Credential: 1. Exemption in eligibility criteria for start-up vendors /MSE vendors: The turn-over and past experience conditions are not applicable for Start-Up or MSE entrepr eneurs subject to meeting of quality and technical specifications. Eligibility of such sellers in terms of the Turnover/ Past performance/ Profitability etc. and also their eligibility for availing various be nefits/advantages in terms of various Govt. Policies/ Guidelines/ acts/ Laws etc. shall be determine d solely on the basis of data fetched/ validated or verified through external agency/ owner of that set of databases such as Income tax/ PAN data base, MCA 21, Udyog Aadhaar, NSIC, GSTN, Certify ing Agencies such as BIS, BEE etc. (i) Exemption in respect of “Past Experience Conditions” means exemption for Clause ‘A3’ only of Qualifying Requirements on Technical Capability. (ii) Exemption in respect of “Turnover” means exemption for Clause ‘B1’ only of Qualifying Requirements on Financial Capability. 2. Requirement to meet eligibility criteria for Start-up/MSE Vendor: (i) Meeting quality and technical specification means executed purchase order/supply order/c omposite order in support of “same or similar category product” to be furnished. Relaxation in eligibility criteria for start-up/ MSE shall be applicable as stated above at 1(i) & 1(ii) only. Any other clause for relaxation in eligibility criteria mentioned elsewhere in the NIT shal l not be considered.
